course_description: Deals with the actual research presented in the proposal. The course output is the completed research to be defended before a panel. This course also includes the practical applications of God’s way of character building through proper handling and presentation of research data.

course_learning_outcomes.text: cultivate a clear and effective field appropriate undergraduate research, using algorithms to explore complex and/or ambiguous ideas and issues;
analyze the requirements needed to improve the current algorithm used in the study;
interpret theories and give recommendations where appropriate;
design and develop a model of the actual study;
recommend a solution to existing problem; and
acquire Lasallian values on the chosen topic and apply the knowledge, experience and skills learned in computer science.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Analyze complex problems, identify and define the computing requirements appropriate to its solution.
Identify and analyze user needs and take them into account in the selection, creation, and evaluation and administration of computer-based systems.
